headline: Sensex Jumps 500 Points, Nifty Surpasses 23,400 as Easing Crude Prices and FII Inflows Boost Market Sentiment

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Easing crude oil prices have provided a significant boost to domestic market sentiment
The return of foreign institutional investors (FIIs) has supported the climb in Sensex and Nifty
Positive global cues from Asian markets and Gift Nifty trends influenced the opening
Strong performance in the FMCG sector and gains in heavyweight stocks like Sun Pharma and HCL Tech
whatHappening: Sensex rose over 500 points to reach a day's high during the trading session
Nifty 50 successfully held above the 23,350 level and topped the 23,400 mark
NMDC and HAL shares rallied by 2% following positive corporate and operational developments
JSW Group companies plan to raise $300 million through bond issuances in the October-December quarter
summary: Sensex and Nifty are trading higher, driven by cooling crude oil prices and a return of foreign funds. NMDC and HAL shares gained 2% on positive operational updates, while Sun Pharma and HCL Tech led the gainers. Investors are also monitoring Tata group stocks amid reports of potential boardroom legal battles.
